summary: Verified the manual-block-tap-must-never-equal-verified-block correction across backend, frontend, and app smoke test. All targeted new tests pass, full regression suites are green (aside from a pre-existing/known flaky item and one newly-observed unrelated third-party email rate-limit flake). Mock-adapter block flow in the app is confirmed UNCHANGED.

minor.issue: Full-suite run hit a 502 on TestConfirmToken::test_confirm_valid_token due to backend log 'email send failed: 429' (Resend API rate limiting), not the pre-registered known-flaky test_family_weekly_push. Re-ran in isolation and it still failed with the same 502 (external Resend rate-limit dependency, not code-change related). Isolated re-run of test_family_weekly_push.py passed 5/5 as expected.

action_items: Kotlin changes (EnforcementEvidence.kt, EnforcementEvidenceTest.kt, ApolloDnsVpnService.kt doc comments) could not be run in this sandbox (no Android toolchain) -- as expected/out of scope, per request.

Investigate the Resend email 429 rate-limit causing an intermittent 502 on POST /api/family/guardians during full-suite parallel runs -- unrelated to this round's enforcement-evidence changes but worth tracking separately since it's a second distinct flaky test now observed in the full suite (in addition to the already-known test_window_and_week_key).
critical_code_review_comments: No code review issues found in the files reviewed this round; changes are additive/corrective and consistent with the stated Truth-of-State intent (manual tap != verified block).

success_rate.backend: 100% for evidence-gate suite (11/11); full suite 218/219 passed on this run (1 failure attributable to third-party email rate-limiting, unrelated to code under test)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (20/20 node unit tests passed; tsc clean except the one pre-existing home.tsx:217 error)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed via browser automation: pasting http://testsafebrowsing.appspot.com/s/phishing.html into 'Check a link' correctly triggers 'Apollo is barking'; tapping 'Block this destination' with the mock adapter shows 'Block not verified: Mock adapter (demo)... still barking' -- event correctly stays in 'barking' state, never jumps to 'biting'. No console errors/crashes during the flow, only pre-existing unrelated deprecation warnings (shadow* / pointerEvents). App boots cleanly after supervisor restart with no blank-screen regression this run.
rca_of_issue: The single backend full-suite failure (test_confirm_valid_token) is caused by the Resend transactional email API returning HTTP 429 (rate limited) to the backend when creating a guardian record that triggers a confirmation email send, which the backend surfaces as a 502 to the client. This is an external dependency/rate-limit issue unrelated to the enforcement-evidence correction under test this round; it reproduced identically on isolated re-run, so it is a real (if pre-existing/environmental) flake, not a regression from this change set.
